signal: BizzyCar launched Service Engine, an AI outbound service solution, at NADA 2026 after a $20M Series B follow-on, adding 100+ rooftops a month

email.body1:
Will, saw BizzyCar launch Service Engine at NADA and keep adding 100-plus rooftops a month after the $20M raise.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market dealers in play than the sales team can cover before the next cohort lands, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for BizzyCar off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Will, quick follow-up for BizzyCar.

Post-raise, pipeline expectations usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings BizzyCar needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Will, last bit of proof for BizzyCar.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how BizzyCar's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Will, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a raise and a product launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a dealer-sales motion? I will tailor it to BizzyCar either way.
